Recompute HCC1395 positional-singleton denominators, M1 stable flags, K distribution, and stability fields.

import pandas as pd
audit = pd.read_csv('positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz', sep='\t')
hcc = audit[(audit.dataset == 'HCC1395') & (audit.ssnv_branch == 'positional_singleton')].copy()
flagged = hcc[(hcc.m1_status == 'FLAGGED') & hcc.stable_null_multigroup.astype(str).str.lower().eq('true')]

穩定性不是只看一張樹

每個點是一個位點。M1 先要求觀察到的群間/群內分離超過門檻，再以 column-shuffle null 校準，最後在 10Source for 10Source: HCC1395 734-site assignment/null stability recountTables: positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz, all_ssnv_stable_multigroup_read_assignments.jsonl.gz 個 seeds 檢查 modal K 與 assignment agreement。堆疊圖顯示保留下來的位點在 grouped read support bins 中的 K 組成；ARI 的最小值另由上方卡片顯示為 1.0Source for 1.0Source: HCC1395 734-site assignment/null stability recountTables: positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz, all_ssnv_stable_multigroup_read_assignments.jsonl.gz。734Source for 734Source: HCC1395 734-site assignment/null stability recountTables: positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz, all_ssnv_stable_multigroup_read_assignments.jsonl.gz 不是只憑視覺挑出的案例。

統計口徑提醒： operational gate 是 observed ratio > interpolated null 95th percentile。因只有 40Source for 40Source: HCC1395 734-site assignment/null stability recountTables: positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz, all_ssnv_stable_multigroup_read_assignments.jsonl.gz shuffles，另算的 empirical rank p 最高可為 3/41=0.0732Source for 0.0732Source: HCC1395 734-site assignment/null stability recountTables: positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz, all_ssnv_stable_multigroup_read_assignments.jsonl.gz；所以不能把 828Source for 828Source: HCC1395 734-site assignment/null stability recountTables: positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz, all_ssnv_stable_multigroup_read_assignments.jsonl.gz 個 splits 改寫成『每個 classical p<0.05Source for 0.05Source: HCC1395 734-site assignment/null stability recountTables: positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz, all_ssnv_stable_multigroup_read_assignments.jsonl.gz』。

代表位點：UPGMA、read-distance 與 read×CpG 怎麼一起看

  1. UPGMA：把 representative focal-ALT reads 依 Bernoulli 甲基距離作 average linkage；看群是否在距離空間分開。
  2. read-distance heatmap：檢查組內較近、組間較遠的 block pattern。
  3. read×CpG heatmap：確認差異來自多個 CpG 的圖樣，而非單一缺失值；灰色保留未呼叫 CpG。

三圖相容才支持 read-level epigenetic partition；仍不等於 cellular lineage tree。

限制與正確結論

  • M1 的 734Source for 734Source: Claim contract v5Table: claim-contract-v5.md 是 統計穩定 methyl multigroup candidates，不是 biological prevalence。
  • 只有 2Source for 2Source: Claim contract v5Table: claim-contract-v5.md 個位點在目前 M2 測量軸下 determinate/PASS；其他 732Source for 732Source: Claim contract v5Table: claim-contract-v5.md 個資訊不足，不能判為反例。
  • 要升級為 clone/subclone 證據，仍需第二個獨立 sSNV marker、tumor-REF/matched-normal control、exact-locus CN/purity/multiplicity/CCF，以及跨技術或 single-cell/colony/spatial 正交驗證。
  • 因此目前最精確的結論是：HCC1395 約 9%Source for 9%Source: Claim contract v5Table: claim-contract-v5.md 可評估 positional-singleton 位點，能在共享 ALT 的 reads 內偵測到可重現的甲基分子子結構。

    Recompute HCC1395 positional-singleton denominators, M1 stable flags, K distribution, and stability fields.

    SQL query
    import pandas as pd
audit = pd.read_csv('positional_singleton_site_audit.tsv.gz', sep='\t')
hcc = audit[(audit.dataset == 'HCC1395') & (audit.ssnv_branch == 'positional_singleton')].copy()
flagged = hcc[(hcc.m1_status == 'FLAGGED') & hcc.stable_null_multigroup.astype(str).str.lower().eq('true')]
